content: During this CrewAI run, validation and repository publishing both failed or were skipped. The root cause was missing upstream artifacts required for validation and publishing: Parsed Requirements Document, Generated Components, configuration files (agents.yaml, tasks.yaml, crew.py, main.py). READY_FOR_PUBLISH was FALSE, as the pipeline could not proceed without these artifacts. Lesson: Always ensure component and requirement parsing succeeds to enable downstream stages. Critical issues were artifact absence, not found by validation itself. Fix recommendation: improve earlier stage resilience and validation artifact checks.
